title: kbmon's live view cuts the log tail at the bottom, so on a short terminal the newest rows are the ones dropped
goal: when the live view has fewer rows than the log has events, mon_view.render_text keeps the newest rows of the log tail (the bottom ones) and drops the oldest, and kb/_self/monitoring.md (Layout, Rows) says so

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_view;snap={'taken':'2026-10-18T10:00:00Z','alerts':[],'panels':{'log':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'events':[{'ts':'2026-10-18T10:00:0%dZ'%i,'source':'ops','event':'land.step','subject':'ST-aaaaaaaa','fields':{},'warn':False} for i in range(9)],'problems':[]}}}};t=mon_view.render_text(snap,height=8);sys.exit(0 if '10:00:08' in t else 1)

gates.question: How does the view keep the log's newest rows when the log has more rows than fit: a plain bottom slice of the whole log body (a problems row, listed first, goes before any event), or problems rows pinned and only events dropped?
options: bottom slice of the body, alert rows counted out first
pin problems rows, drop oldest events
gates.recommendation: bottom slice of the body, alert rows counted out first
gates.answer: bottom slice of the body, alert rows counted out first
